meta.description: Receives signed scene.verification.completed / scene.real_generated events and resumes the Wait node. Re-fetches ASF API before advancing.

parameters.content:
If verified=true, resume Workflow A Wait node (use n8n Wait webhook resume URL stored per correlation_id).
If verified=false, notify operator — do NOT advance and do NOT re-submit Flow.
Duplicate callbacks must not advance twice (idempotency handled above).
